auth_registration.description: Issues or feedback regarding sign-in, account creation, electronic ID verification, and password resets.

tech_stability_crash.description: Reports of app crashes, endless loading screens, server connection errors, and overall technical instability.

general_feedback.description: Broad opinions, general satisfaction, or non-specific praise/criticism about the app or the health insurance provider.

document_management.description: Feedback on uploading invoices, submitting sick notes (AU), and managing digital mail/documents.

smarthealth_epa_features.description: Feedback specifically related to the electronic patient record (ePA), digital prescriptions, and Smart Health integrations.

usability_ui.description: Feedback on the user interface, navigation, layout, and overall ease of use.

customer_service.description: Mentions of hotlines, email support, staff helpfulness, or response times.

updates_versions.description: Issues or feedback directly related to recent app updates, forced updates, or device compatibility.
